name: TC Diff Processor
description: Text diff processor for path pipelines. Line-level unified diff, similarity ratio, patch application, word-level diff. Zero external dependencies, stdlib difflib only.
description_zh: 路径管道用文本差异处理工具。行级统一差异、相似度比、补丁应用、词级差异。零外部依赖，纯 stdlib difflib。

directives.usage_zh: 文本差异;统一差异,<文本A>,<文本B>[,<上下文行数>,<标签A>,<标签B>]
directives.description: Generate unified diff between two texts. Returns has_diff flag for fast no-change routing in paths.
directives.description_zh: 生成两段文本的统一差异。返回 has_diff 标志供路径中快速略过无变化。

params_desc.label_a: Old version label in --- line (default: a)
params_desc.label_b: New version label in +++ line (default: b)

directives.usage_zh: 文本差异;相似度,<文本A>,<文本B>
directives.description: Calculate similarity ratio (0.0-1.0) and line counts. Use as a decision point before doing full diff.
directives.description_zh: 计算相似度比 (0.0-1.0) 和行数统计。用在全量差异前做决策判断。

directives.usage_zh: 文本差异;应用补丁,<原始文本>,<差异文本>
directives.description: Apply a unified diff to the original text, returning the patched result. Reports conflicts with hunks_applied/hunks_total.
directives.description_zh: 将统一差异文本应用到原始文本，返回补丁后的结果。报告冲突及应用进度 (hunks_applied/hunks_total)。

directives.usage_zh: 文本差异;词级差异,<文本A>,<文本B>[,<格式>]
directives.description: Word-level diff with ops or HTML output. Ops format: [{type: equal/replace/delete/insert, ...}] for pipeline consumption. HTML format: inline <del>/<ins> for direct rendering.
directives.description_zh: 词级差异对比，输出 ops 或 HTML 格式。ops: [{type: equal/replace/delete/insert, ...}] 供管道消费。HTML: 内联 <del>/<ins> 直接渲染。
